title: Bach Cello Suite No. 1, BWV 1007 — Prélude
notes: Bach autograph lost; editions differ (esp. bowings). This reference uses Mutopia/Schirmer pitch+rhythm as ground truth for monophonic cello. Bowings/slurs are non-authoritative. Written at c' then transposed c→c, for cello sounding pitch. Polyphonic <<>> inserts near the end were dropped.
